outcome: endometrial gene expression (related to proliferation of blood vessel endothelial cells, endothelial cells, and epithelial cells)
abnormal apoptosis of endometrial epithelial cells
cohort: The study participants were women with Cesarean section scar diverticulum (CSD) and a control group without CSD.
finding: The study revealed that abnormal cervical microbiota, characterized by higher diversity, decreased Lactobacillus, and elevated potentially harmful species, along with altered metabolomic and endometrial transcriptomic profiles, is associated with and likely contributes to the pathogenesis of Cesarean section scar diverticulum (CSD).
